{{Quote|Beautiful NX-1200. The pilot's chair was all worn in, I had the thrusters calibrated just how I like 'em...|Captain Ari Skyff, lamenting the loss of the ''Corvani''|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''''Corvani''''' was a [[NX-1200]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] operated by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Ari Skyff]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was outfitted with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], a glass cockpit, and a fifteen cylinder-hyperdrive with overload protection. In [[3643 BBY]], The ''Corvani'' was shot down by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]] above the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] while being used to supply the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-backed [[Balmorran resistance]]. [[Ari Skyff]] deployed an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to survive the crash, but the ship and its cargo of weapons and medical supplies was lost.
Skyff recruited a passing Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to recover the cargo and bring back a piece of the ''Corvani'' to serve as a memento.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Corvani''{{'s}} wreckage is the site of the Republic mission "Lost Love" on Balmorra in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the Imperial version of the world, the ship at the crash site is instead called the ''[[Meridian Grace]]'' and is the subject of the mission "Gift of the Exiles."
